say:1:1536117501:1.text: Why wouldn't he? He's the winner of the Bloodhunt!
say:1:1536117501:1.source_cn: 怎么不要呀？这可是猎血节的勇士！
say:1:1536117501:1.male: Why wouldn't he? He's the winner of the Bloodhunt!
say:1:1536117501:1.female: Why wouldn't he? He's the winner of the Bloodhunt!

say:2:1536117502:1.text: A warrior chosen by the Hunting Goddess deserves only the best. Flowers are part of that!
say:2:1536117502:1.source_cn: 被狩猎神选中的勇士，当然值得最好的！也包括花！
say:2:1536117502:1.male: A warrior chosen by the Hunting Goddess deserves only the best. Flowers are part of that!
say:2:1536117502:1.female: A warrior chosen by the Hunting Goddess deserves only the best. Flowers are part of that!

say:4:1536117503:1.text: One flower! No, make it three! I'm going to wear them when I go see Nazrik!
say:4:1536117503:1.source_cn: 我要一朵！不，我要三朵！我要戴上它们去见那非！

say:5:1536117504:1.text: Two rabbit pelts for each! Here, take these—they're as red as fresh blood!
say:5:1536117504:1.source_cn: 两张兔皮换一朵！给你这几朵吧，它们像血一样鲜红！
